shots.description: Cover: mid-course flight over the archipelago, ring 3 ahead, city and coastline below, full HUD with altitude, speed and heading.
Flying straight at ring 2 over open sea, HUD lit, islands ahead.
Final approach: gear down, runway 09 ahead with edge lights and windsock, altitude and speed on the HUD.
Title screen with the three sortie cards and the controls card.
